candidates.text:
OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM:
1. In purchase order from buyers list we have an option to ‘Update’ the order and same handling we need to do on that screen.
2. Current selling price, current discount definition, current discount percentage, current effective selling price, new discount percentage, new effective selling price will always come in read only mode.
3. New selling price, new discount definition will come in editable mode.
4. Whenever the user updates the New Selling Price or New Discount Definition, the system shall automatically recalculate and update the New Discount Percentage and New Effective Selling Price.
5. A new user permission shall be introduced to control the revision of Discount Definition during Sales Order revision.
6. Permission name ‘Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order’.
7. It will applicable on User Interface (UI), Update Order Confirmation, EDI Package.
8. If the logged-in user does not have the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission: The New Discount Definition field shall remain read-only/disabled.
9. User Has Permission (Without Approval Hierarchy): The new/revised Sales Order shall be updated immediately without sending the new/revised order to any approver authority.
10. User Has Permission with Approval Hierarchy: If the new/revision results in a change to the Effective Selling Price, the new/revised Sales Order shall not be updated immediately, the system shall create an Approval Request and route it to the configured higher-level approver based on the organization's Approval Hierarchy.
11. Total value should need to be validated by “Effective selling price’.

chunks.title: 1. Business Requirement
chunks.heading: 1. Business Requirement
chunks.text:
currently, users maintain Commission Agent and Commission Percentage in Buyer Master under Commission Definition. During Sales Invoice Clear & Posting, users are again required to manually select Commission % and Supplier before posting the invoice even when the information already exists in Buyer Master. This enhancement will automate the population of commission details, enforce mandatory validation, and provide controlled flexibility through user permissions.
In addition, the system currently does not provide a centralized mechanism to maintain Buyer-specific Discount Definitions based on business attributes such as Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category. As a result, users are unable to configure multiple discounts, define default discounts, or maintain discount applicability in a structured and reusable manner.
2. Objectives
• Reduce manual data entry during Sales Invoice Clear & Posting.
• Automatically populate commission details from Buyer Master.
• Ensure commission details are mandatory when applicable.
• Allow authorized users to edit or bypass commission validation.
• Improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
• Provide a centralized mechanism to maintain Buyer-specific Discount Definitions within the Buyer Master.
chunks.locator: § 1. Business Requirement

chunks.title: 3. Scope
chunks.heading: 3. Scope
chunks.text:
• Auto-population of Commission % and Supplier from Buyer Master.
• Mandatory validation during Sales Invoice Clear & Posting.
• Support for multiple commission definitions.
• New user permission to bypass/edit commission.
• Introduce a new Discount Definition section under the Buyer Master → Financial Info tab.
• Automatic application of Discount Definitions during Sales Order.
• Changes to existing functionality of sales order, costing & shipment invoice.

• The Buyer Department field shall display all active Buyer Departments configured for the selected Buyer.
• The Product Group field shall display all active Product Groups belonging to the selected Category.
• The Sub Category field shall display all active Sub Categories corresponding to the selected Product Group.
• ALL Other shall indicate that the discount definition is applicable to all Buyer Departments, Product Group, Sub Category that are not explicitly configured.
• Add – To create a new Discount Definition record.
• Delete – To delete the selected Discount Definition record.
• Log – To view the audit history of all additions, modifications, and deletions performed on the Discount Definition records.

chunks.title: Discount Definition Details
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › Discount Definition Details
chunks.text:
• The system shall allow multiple Discount records to be maintained for a single Discount Definition.
• The same Discount Name shall not be allowed more than once within the same Discount Definition record.
• Only one Discount can be marked as Default for a Discount Definition.
• The Default field shall be displayed as a Radio Button, ensuring that only one Discount can be selected as the default.
• If only one Discount record exists, the system shall automatically mark it as the Default.
• The Discount Percentage (%) shall accept only numeric values within the permissible range defined by the system (for example, 0.00–100.00).
chunks.locator: § B) Discount Handling › Discount Definition Details

chunks.title: OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.text:
• At the time of Sales Order Creation, the system shall provide a Discount Definition dropdown below the Selling Price field, it will be handled by ‘OC/Sales ASN/GMPO Setting’ (with visible and mandatory option).
• Only the matching Active Discount Definitions configured in the Buyer Master (for particular category, buyer department, product group, sub category) shall be displayed.
• The dropdown shall display the values in the following format:
Discount Name (Discount %)
• The Discount Definition dropdown shall support multiple selection, Default discount definition should need to come automatically.
• Upon selection of one or more Discount Definitions, the system shall automatically calculate the Total Discount Percentage by summing the Discount Percentage of all selected Discount Definitions.
chunks.locator: § B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM

chunks.title: OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.text:
• The Discount Percentage & Effective Selling Price field shall be read-only, and users shall not be permitted to modify it manually.
• The system shall automatically calculate the Effective Selling Price based on the Selling Price and Total Discount Percentage.
Effective Selling Price = Selling Price − (Selling Price × Total Discount Percentage ÷ 100).
• The values displayed in the Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price columns shall depend on the selected Price Per option in the Sales Order.
• The same Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price shall be displayed for all rows in the Quantity Breakup grid in case of price per is ‘Article’.
• The Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Color in case of price per is ‘Color’.
• The Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Size in case of price per is ‘Size’.
• The Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Color/Size combination in case of price per is ‘Color/Size’.
• Once a Sales Order Delivery (DOC) has been partially or fully dispatched, the system shall restrict any modification to the Discount Definition from UI/EDI/LLM.
chunks.locator: § B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM

chunks.title: OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.text:
• In purchase order from buyers list we have an option to ‘Update’ the order and same handling we need to do on that screen.
• Current selling price, current discount definition, current discount percentage, current effective selling price, new discount percentage, new effective selling price will always come in read only mode.
• New selling price, new discount definition will come in editable mode.
• Whenever the user updates the New Selling Price or New Discount Definition, the system shall automatically recalculate and update the New Discount Percentage and New Effective Selling Price.
• A new user permission shall be introduced to control the revision of Discount Definition during Sales Order revision.
• Permission name ‘Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order’.
• It will applicable on User Interface (UI), Update Order Confirmation, EDI Package.
• If the logged-in user does not have the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission: The New Discount Definition field shall remain read-only/disabled.
• User Has Permission (Without Approval Hierarchy): The new/revised Sales Order shall be updated immediately without sending the new/revised order to any approver authority.
chunks.locator: § B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM

chunks.title: OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
chunks.text:
• User Has Permission with Approval Hierarchy: If the new/revision results in a change to the Effective Selling Price, the new/revised Sales Order shall not be updated immediately, the system shall create an Approval Request and route it to the configured higher-level approver based on the organization's Approval Hierarchy.
• Total value should need to be validated by “Effective selling price’.
It will be applicable for all Group By ‘Summary’, ‘Market’, ‘Destination’, ‘Delivery’.
Two more column discount percentage and effective selling price require in all sales order view, Group by: - ‘Summary’, ‘Market’, ‘Destination’, ‘Delivery’.
• At the time of sales order creation or revision by EDI package ‘Discount definition’ column will be enabled based on ‘OC/Sales ASN/GMPO’ setting and visibility is mentioned below:

chunks.title: Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’
chunks.text:
• As discussion with ‘Shahi team’ they always create the cost sheet in ‘INR’ currency and cost sheet exchange rate and other transaction exchange rate can also be different.
• So, in that case we mention the ROE under FA >> Master Definitions >> Exchange Rate >> Exchange Rate >> Cost Sheet Exchange Rate, where user able to mention the ROE for multiple currencies.
• As discussed with Shahi team ROE should not allow to change at the time of cost sheet creation, so if enable the cost sheet exchange rate master system will always pick the ROE based on the cost sheet exchange rate master.
• If there are multiple ‘delivery OC’ attached on particular BOM with multiple ‘Currency’ so first system needs to calculate the value in ‘INR’ and after that convert it into the other currency ($ to show in master cost sheet print).
• These changes will not any impacts on ‘Sewtech company’ in case delivery OC currency is not used and the all calculations will be applicable based on ‘Main OC Currency’ and calculate the ‘Average FOB’.
• Required two more column in master cost sheet Discount % and Effective FOB

chunks.title: Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’
chunks.text:
• FOB ($) = Total Value in INR/Total Qty * ROE (Mentioned in cs exchange rate master).
• Discount Percentage = (100 × 5 + 200 × 10 + 50 × 2) ÷ 350 = 7.43%.
• Effective FOB ($) = FOB ($) – Discount Percentage.
• Column Name ‘A’, FOB in USD = Effective FOB ($).
• Column Name ‘B’, Conversion Rate = based on cs exchange rate master data will come here.
• Column Name ‘C’, FOB in INR= A*B.
• Column Name ‘D’,’E’,’F’, Duty drawback, ROSCTL, Notional Duty drawback = Will applicable based on ‘Effective Selling Price or FOB in INR’.
• Column Name ‘G’, Total realisation in INR= Based on column C+D+E+F.
• Column Name ‘H’, Total cost price same as per existing.
• Column Name ‘I’, Margin in INR= G-H.
• Column Name ‘J’, Margin in %=I/G.
• Ttl Sales =
• Ttl Margin + dbk=
• Margin/Gmt= Similar of column name ‘J’.
• INR= Similar of column name ‘I’.
• Same changes will applicable on WFX ‘Master Cost Sheet’ & WFX BI Report ‘Master Cost Sheet’.

chunks.title: Sales ASN & Sales Invoice Impacts
chunks.heading: B) Discount Handling › Sales ASN & Sales Invoice Impacts
chunks.text:
System should show the ‘Effective Price’ at the time of sales ASN creation, Customer Dr with Net FOB & Sales Cr with Net FOB.
• The Discount Percentage and Effective Price fields shall always remain read-only. These values shall be system-calculated, and users shall not be permitted to edit or override them manually.
• If need to be done user will apply the additional charges.
• In sales invoice also the same information need to follow and value should need to be calculate based on ‘Effective Price’.
• Effects also require at the time of ‘Shipping Bill’ & ‘Shipment Plan’-Need to discuss with product team and Yudesh sir.

chunks.title: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.heading: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.text:
• Single commission definition auto-populates successfully.
• Multiple commission definitions required manual selection.
• No commission definition follows existing behaviour.
• FA Setting disabled – feature inactive.
• Mandatory validation prevents posting without commission details.
• Users with bypass permission can edit or skip commission details.
• Accounting entries and Credit Note generation remain unchanged.
• Discount Definition is successfully maintained in the Buyer Master based on Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
• Only applicable and Active Discount Definitions are displayed in the Sales Order based on the selected Buyer, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
• Users can select multiple Discount Definitions using the multi-select checkbox control.
• Discount Definitions are displayed in the format Discount Name (Discount %).
• The Discount Percentage is automatically calculated as the sum of all selected Discount Definitions and remains read-only.
• The Effective Selling Price is automatically calculated based on the Selling Price and total Discount Percentage and remains read-only.
• Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly across all supported Price Per options (Article, Color, Size, and Color/Size).
• The Total Value is calculated using the Effective Selling Price.
chunks.locator: § 5. Acceptance Criteria

chunks.title: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.heading: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.text:
• Duplicate Discount Names are not allowed within the same Discount Definition in Buyer Master.
• Only one Discount can be marked as the Default within a Discount Definition.
• Users without the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission cannot modify the Discount Definition through UI, EDI, LLM, or other integrations.
• Users with the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission can modify the Discount Definition during Sales Order revision.
• If Approval Hierarchy is enabled, any revision that changes the Effective Selling Price is routed for approval before the changes become effective.
• Discount Definition cannot be revised once the Sales Order has been partially or fully dispatched.
• Discount Definition, Discount Percentage, and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly in all applicable screens, including Sales Order, Quantity Breakup, Update Order Confirmation, EDI Buyer PO, and Color/Size Detail.
• Existing Sales Order processing, dispatch, invoicing, accounting, and financial postings remain unaffected by this enhancement.
chunks.locator: § 5. Acceptance Criteria (part 2)
